Rashi on Bava Kamma 5a:10:1.english: Rather, what does the number of Rabbi Ḥiyya come to exclude - [That is, what is there] that he does not count among them?

Rashi on Bava Kamma 5a:11:1.english: An informer - An informer who hands over his fellow's property to an idolater.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 5a:11:2.hebrew: ומפגל - כהן ששחט קרבנו של ישראל, חטאת לשום שלמים, דאין הקרבן עולה לחובת בעליו, וצריך אחר:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 5a:11:2.english: And one who renders [an offering] piggul - A priest who slaughtered the offering of an Israelite, [such as] a sin-offering for the sake of a peace-offering, for the offering does not count toward the obligation of its owner, and [the owner] requires another [offering].

Rashi on Bava Kamma 5a:12:1.english: And let him teach it - [Let] Rabbi Ḥiyya [teach] this [case of an] informer.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 5a:13:1.english: A defamer is speech that involves an action - [The action is] intercourse.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 5a:15:1.hebrew: מכלל דאיכא תולדות - כדפרשינן לעיל לכל חד וחד, נגיפה ונשיכה לקרן, נתחככה להנאתה תולדה דשן, וכן לכולן:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 5a:15:1.english: Implying that there are secondary categories - As we explained above for each and every one: butting and biting for Horn, rubbing [itself] for its pleasure [is] a secondary category of Tooth, and so for all of them.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 5a:17:1.hebrew: תחת נתינה כו' - דבכולהו כתיב: או תחת, וגמרינן תחת תחת משור מועד, דכתיב ביה שור תחת השור; מה התם ממיטב, דגמר משן ורגל דכתיב ביה מיטב שדהו, אף כאן מיטב, שאם בא לשלם קרקע לניזק בשביל הזיקו — מגביהו מן העידית; או נתינה, וגמר נתינה נתינה משור שנגח את העבד, דכתיב ביה יתן לאדוניו; או ישלם, וגמר משן ורגל, דכתיב בהן מיטב כרמו ישלם; או כסף, וגמרי מבור, דכתיב ביה כסף ישיב לבעליו. וארבע אבות גמירי כולהו משן ורגל. בשומר חנם כתיב: אשר ירשיעון אלהים ישלם; בשואל כתיב: בעליו אין עמו שלם ישלם; בנושא שכר כתיב: אם גנוב יגנב מעמו ישלם; שוכר אינו כתוב בתורה, אבל דינו כנושא שכר. בנזק דחובל בחבירו כתיב נתינה: כן ינתן בו, והיינו ממון הניתן מיד ליד, כדדרשינן בהחובל (לקמן בבא קמא דף פד.); בצער כתיב: פצע תחת פצע, ודרשינן ליה לקמן בהחובל (בבא קמא דף פה.): פצע תחת פצע — ליתן צער במקום נזק; בריפוי ושבת כתיב נתינה: שבתו יתן ורפא; ובשבת כתיב תחת גבי אונס ומפתה, דכתיב: תחת אשר עינה, ודרשינן בכתובות בפרק אלו נערות (כתובות דף מ:): חמשים כסף תחת העינוי — מכלל דאיכא בושת ופגם. לישנא אחרינא: הואיל וכתיב בחובל בחבירו תחת, דכתיב: תחת פצע — כולהו חמשה דברים דידיה מהתם גמרינן. בתשלומי כפל כתיב: ישלם שנים; ובתשלומי ארבעה וחמשה כתיב: חמשה בקר ישלם תחת וגו'; וקרן דגנב בכלל כפל הוא; ובגזל כתיב נתינה: ונתן לאשר אשם לו (במדבר ה׳:ז׳); בעדים זוממין כתיב בהו: נפש בנפש (דברים י״ט:כ״א), וכמאן דכתיב תחת דמי; באונס ומפתה ומוציא שם רע כתיב כסף: ונתן לאבי הנערה חמשים כסף (שם כב) — היינו אונס; מפתה: כסף ישקול כמוהר הבתולות (שמות כ״ב:ט״ז); במוציא שם רע: וענשו אותו מאה כסף (דברים כ״ב:י״ט); מטמא ומדמע ומנסך בכלל נזק הן, ובנזק כתיב ביה תחת:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 5a:17:1.english: Instead of, giving, etc. - For in all of them, either "instead of" [tachat] is written, and we derive [by a verbal analogy of] "instead of" [from] "instead of" from a forewarned ox, concerning which it is written: "an ox instead of the ox" [Exodus 21:36] — just as there [payment is made] from the best-quality [land], as it derives from Tooth and Foot, concerning which it is written: "the best of his field [and the best of his vineyard he shall pay]" [Exodus 22:4], so too here [payment is made from] the best-quality [land], such that if he comes to pay land to the injured party for his damage, [the court] collects for him from the superior-quality land; or "giving" [netinah] is written, and it derives [by an analogy of] "giving" [from] "giving" from an ox that gored a slave, concerning which it is written: "[thirty shekels of silver] he shall give to his master" [Exodus 21:32]; or "he shall pay" [yeshalem] is written, and it derives from Tooth and Foot, concerning which it is written: "the best of his vineyard he shall pay" [Exodus 22:4]; or "money" [kesef] is written, and we derive [it] from Pit, concerning which it is written: "money he shall return to its owner" [Exodus 21:34]. And the four primary categories [themselves] all derive [their obligation to pay from the best-quality land] from Tooth and Foot. Regarding an unpaid bailee, it is written: "whom the judges shall condemn, he shall pay [double to his neighbor]" [Exodus 22:8]; regarding a borrower, it is written: "[if] its owner is not with it, he shall surely pay" [Exodus 22:13]; regarding a paid bailee, it is written: "If it be stolen from him, he shall pay [to its owner]" [Exodus 22:11]; a renter is not written [explicitly] in the Torah, but his legal status is like [that of] a paid bailee. Regarding [the compensation for] damage when one injures another person, "giving" is written: "so shall it be given to him" [Leviticus 24:20], and this refers to monetary payment that is given from hand to hand, as we expound in [Perek] HaChovel (below, Bava Kamma 84a); regarding pain, it is written: "wound for wound" [Exodus 21:25], and we expound it below in [Perek] HaChovel (Bava Kamma 85a): "'wound for wound' — to pay for pain where there is damage"; regarding medical expenses and loss of livelihood, "giving" is written: "[only] for his cessation [from work] he shall give, and he shall cause him to be thoroughly healed" [Exodus 21:19]; and regarding humiliation [the printed text reads "loss of livelihood" (shevet), but refers to humiliation (boshet)], "instead of" [tachat] is written regarding a rapist and a seducer, as it is written: "because [tachat] he violated her" [Deuteronomy 22:29], and we expound in Ketubot in the chapter [entitled] Elu Na'arot (Ketubot 40b): "fifty silver [shekels] are for the violation [tachat ha'inui] — which implies that there is [also compensation for] humiliation and degradation." Another formulation: Since "instead of" [tachat] is written regarding one who injures another person, as it is written: "wound for [tachat] wound," all five of his items [of indemnity] are derived from there. Regarding double payment, it is written: "he shall pay double" [Exodus 22:3, 22:6, 22:8]; and regarding four- and five-fold payments, it is written: "five cattle he shall pay instead of [the ox] etc." [Exodus 21:37]; and the principal payment of a thief is included in double payment; and regarding robbery, "giving" is written: "and he shall give it to him to whom he is guilty" (Numbers 5:7); regarding conspiring witnesses, it is written concerning them: "life for life" (Deuteronomy 19:21), which is equivalent to writing "instead of" [tachat]; regarding a rapist, a seducer, and a defamer, "silver" is written: "and he shall give to the father of the damsel fifty silver [shekels]" (ibid. 22:29) — this is a rapist; regarding a seducer: "he shall weigh silver according to the bride-price of virgins" (Exodus 22:16); regarding a defamer: "and they shall fine him one hundred silver [shekels]" (Deuteronomy 22:19); one who defiles [another's food], one who mixes [terumah into non-sacred produce], and one who libates [another's wine to idolatry] are included in [the general category of] damage, and regarding damage, "instead of" [tachat] is written in it.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 5a:18:1.english: What is it saying - Why do I need [the mishna] to teach [this] at all?

Rashi on Bava Kamma 5a:18:2.hebrew: ותיתי אידך מינה - במה מצינו בשור שהוא מזיק וחייב, אף המבעה שהוא מזיק יהא חייב:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 5a:18:2.english: And let the other be derived from it - Through [the principle of] "just as we find": Just as regarding an ox, it causes damage and [its owner] is liable, so too the *maveh*, which causes damage, should [its owner] be liable.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 5a:18:3.hebrew: לא אתיא - כדמפרש לעיל, רב לטעמיה ושמואל לטעמיה:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 5a:18:3.english: It cannot be derived - As is explained above, Rav according to his reasoning, and Shmuel according to his reasoning.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 5a:1:1.hebrew: עדים זוממין דממונא הוא - דכל המשלם יותר ע"מ שהזיק, כגון כפל ותשלומי ארבעה וחמשה, קרי קנס, כדלקמן בהך פירקין (בבא קמא ד' טו:), וכגון כל דבר קצוב האמור בתורה, כגון חמשים של אונס ומפתה, ומאה של מוציא שם רע — כולהו הוי קנסא, אבל מידי אחרינא ממונא:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 5a:1:1.english: Conspiring witnesses, which is monetary restitution - For anyone who pays more than what he damaged, such as double payment and fourfold and fivefold payment, [which the tanna] calls a fine, as [stated] below in this chapter (Bava Kamma 15b), and such as any fixed amount stated in the Torah, such as the fifty [shekels] of the rapist and the seducer, and the hundred [shekels] of the defamer — all of these are a fine, but anything else is monetary restitution.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 5a:1:2.hebrew: סבר לה כר"ע - דאמר במס' מכות בפ"ק (ד' ג.): עדים זוממין אין משלמים על פי עצמן. כגון אם הוזמו בב"ד זה, ולא הספיק בעל דין להעמידן בדין ולתובען, והלכו למקום אחר והודו שם בב"ד, ואמרו: ״הוזמנו בבית דינו של פלוני״ – פטורין. אלמא קנסא הוא, ומודה בקנס פטור:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 5a:1:2.english: He holds in accordance with Rabbi Akiva - For [Rabbi Akiva] said in Tractate Makkot, in the first chapter (3a): Conspiring witnesses do not pay on the basis of their own [admission]. For example, if they were rendered conspiring witnesses in this court, and the litigant did not have time to bring them to court and claim [payment from] them, and they went to another place and admitted there in court, saying, "We were rendered conspiring witnesses in the court of So-and-so," they are exempt. Evidently, it is a fine, and one who admits to a fine is exempt.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 5a:2:1.hebrew: אי ר"ע ליתני תרי גווני שור - דהא לר"ע יש חילוק בין תשלומין של שור דאזיק שור, דלא משלם אלא חצי נזק, לתשלומי שור דאזיק אדם, דתנן לקמן בפ' המניח את הכד (בבא קמא דף לג.), ר"ע אומר כו':
Rashi on Bava Kamma 5a:2:1.english: If [he holds like] Rabbi Akiva, let him teach two types of ox - For according to Rabbi Akiva, there is a distinction between the payment for an ox that damaged an ox, where [the owner] pays only half-damages, and the payment for an ox that injured a person, as we learned below in the chapter 'Hamaniach Et Hakad' (Bava Kamma 33a): "Rabbi Akiva says, etc."

Rashi on Bava Kamma 5a:3:1.hebrew: במותר - אם חבל אדם בשור תם, ותם באדם, ושמו ב"ד חבלה שחבל שור באדם יותר מחבלה שחבל האדם בשור, משלם בעל השור אותו עודף:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 5a:3:1.english: For the surplus - If a person injured an innocuous ox, and the innocuous [ox injured] the person, and the court assessed that the injury that the ox inflicted upon the person was greater than the injury that the person inflicted upon the ox, the owner of the ox pays that surplus.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 5a:4:1.hebrew: לגזיזיה - לכח אגרופו, כדאמר בסנהדרין בפ"ק (דף ז.): אדייה לגזיזה וקם:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 5a:4:1.english: His fist - [This refers] to the force of his fist, as [the Gemara] says in Sanhedrin in the first chapter (7a): "He raised his fist and stood."

Rashi on Bava Kamma 5a:4:2.hebrew: יכול ישלם תם שחבל באדם מן העלייה ת"ל כו' - ואשתכח דלא משלם נזק שלם, אלא כמו שהשור שוה:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 5a:4:2.english: One might think that an innocuous [ox] that injured a person would pay from superior-quality property; the verse states, etc. - And it turns out that he does not pay full damages, but rather only as much as the ox is worth.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 5a:5:1.hebrew: אונס ומפתה דממונא הוא - שחמשים כסף לבד הוי קנס, אבל יש בו פגם, ששוה עכשיו פחות מדמעיקרא, כדאמר בכתובות (דף מ.), ובושת, דממונא הוא:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 5a:5:1.english: The rapist and the seducer, for it is monetary compensation - For the fifty [shekels of] silver alone is a fine, but it includes [payment for] degradation — for she is now worth less than beforehand, as [the Gemara] says in Ketubot (40a) — and shame, which is monetary compensation.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 5a:6:1.hebrew: ה"ג מה נפשך - משום מאי איצטריך ליה למיתני, אי משום צער תנא ליה:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 5a:6:1.english: This is the reading: Whichever way you look at it - On account of what was it necessary for him to teach [them]? If on account of pain, he [already] taught it.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 5a:7:1.hebrew: מדמע - מערב תרומה עם חולין של חבירו, דהשתא מזבין להו בזול, לפי שאין יכול לאוכלה אלא כהן:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 5a:7:1.english: One who causes a mixture [of teruma] - [One who] mixes teruma with his fellow's non-sacred produce, so that now [the owner] sells it cheaply, because no one can eat it except for a priest.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 5a:7:2.hebrew: מנסך - שניסך יין חבירו לע"ז ואסרו בהנאה, הואיל ועביד ביה מעשה בגופיה דיין:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 5a:7:2.english: One who pours a libation - [One] who poured his fellow's wine as a libation for idolatry and prohibited it from benefit, since he performed an action upon the body of the wine itself.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 5a:8:1.hebrew: שאינו ניכר - כגון הכא, דאין הנזק ניכר בתוך הפירות, דלא חסר להו:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 5a:8:1.english: That is not discernible - For example here, where the damage is not discernible within the produce, as they are not diminished.

Rashi on Bava Kamma 5a:9:1.hebrew: לימא קסבר רבי חייא לא שמיה היזק - ומשום דקנס הוא תני, דלא הוי בכלל אבות דרבי אושעיא:
Rashi on Bava Kamma 5a:9:1.english: Shall we say Rabbi Ḥiyya holds that it is not considered damage - And [it was] because it is a fine that he taught [it], as it was not included among Rabbi Oshaya's primary categories.

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 5a:10:1.hebrew: תני מניינא למעוטי - האי למעוטי לאו משום דלית ליה דרבי חייא, אלא כלומר: למעוטי דלא איירי בהו:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 5a:10:1.english: He taught the count to exclude - This "to exclude" is not because he does not accept [the view of] Rabbi Ḥiyya; rather, that is to say: to exclude [in the sense] that he does not deal with them.

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 5a:11:1.hebrew: למעוטי מוסר כו' - המ"ל: למעוטי כופר ושלשים של עבד. והא דלא קתני להו, משום דבקטלא לא מיירי. ומוסר ומפגל, אפילו למאן דלא דאין דינא דגרמי, מחייב משום קנס בהגוזל בתרא (לקמן בבא קמא דף קיז.):
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 5a:11:1.english: To exclude an informer, etc. - [The Gemara] could have said: To exclude ransom (kofer) and thirty [shekels] of a slave; and the fact that [the Tanna] does not teach them is because he does not deal with [cases of] killing. And [as for] an informer (moser) and one who renders [an offering] piggul (mefagel) — even according to the one who does not judge the law of indirect damage (dina de-garmi), one is liable by reason of a penalty in [the chapter] HaGozel Batra (below, Bava Kamma 117a).

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 5a:13:1.hebrew: דיבורא דאית ביה מעשה - דבכתובות בפ' נערה (כתובות דף מו.), א"ר אליעזר בן יעקב: לא נאמרו דברים הללו אלא כשבעל; ור' יהודה אית ליה התם: עד שישכור עדים:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 5a:13:1.english: Speech that involves an action - For in Ketubot, in the chapter "Na'arah" (Ketubot 46a), Rabbi Eliezer ben Yaakov said: "These matters were stated only when he had intercourse"; and Rabbi Yehudah holds there: "Until he hires witnesses."

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 5a:16:1.hebrew: כולם כאבות לשלם ממיטב - ואע"ג דתולדות דאבות דמתניתין משלמין נמי ממיטב, מ"מ הני, אי לאו דקרינא להו אבות, לא הוי ידעי דמשלמי ממיטב:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 5a:16:1.english: All of them are like primary categories to pay from the best-quality land - And even though the subcategories of the primary categories of our Mishnah also pay from the best-quality land, nevertheless, regarding these, if we had not called them primary categories, we would not have known that they pay from the best-quality land.

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 5a:17:1.hebrew: תחת נתינה כו' - בספרי מפיק בושת מוקצותה את כפה ולא תחוס עיניך (דברים כה), ויליף מעדים זוממין, דכתיב: לא תחוס עיניך (שם יט). וא"ל שהוא גזירה שוה גמורה, מדלא קאמר: אתיא תחת נתינת עיניך. ועדים זוממים, פרש"י: דכתיב בהו נפש בנפש. וצ"ל: דאפילו אם העידו על שור תם שהזיק, או העידו: פלוני חייב לפלוני מנה, דדינו בזיבורית, דמשלמי במיטב; דאם רצו לחייב אחרים ממיטב, לא צריך קרא, דמכאשר זמם נפקא דיתחייבו ממיטב:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 5a:17:1.english: "In place of" (tachat), "giving" (netinah), etc. - In the Sifrei, it derives [the compensation for] embarrassment (boshet) from "and you shall cut off her hand, your eye shall not pity" (Deuteronomy 25:12), and it derives [it] from conspiring witnesses (edim zomemim), concerning whom it is written: "Your eye shall not pity" (ibid. 19:21). And one cannot say that it is a full verbal analogy (gezeirah shavah) [such that it would teach payment from best-quality land], since [the Gemara] does not say: "It is derived [from] tachat, netinah, [and] einecha [your eye]." And regarding conspiring witnesses, Rashi explained that it is written concerning them: "Life for life" (nefesh be-nefesh) [which is equivalent to "in place of" (tachat)]. And one must say that even if they testified about an innocuous ox (shor tam) that caused damage, or they testified, "So-and-so owes so-and-so a maneh," whose legal status is [to be paid] from inferior-quality land (ziburit), they pay from best-quality land (meitav); for if they sought to obligate others [to pay] from best-quality land, a verse is not needed, since from "as he conspired" (ka'asher zamam) it is derived that they would be obligated [to pay] from best-quality land.

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 5a:18:1.hebrew: מאי קאמר - משום דלא מצי לפרושי האי לא הרי כשאר לא הרי שבש"ס, קמתמה: מאי קאמר:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 5a:18:1.english: What is he saying - Because it is not possible to explain this "not the aspect of" (lo harei) like the other [instances of] "not the aspect of" (lo harei) in the Talmud (Shas), [the Gemara] wonders: "What is he saying?"

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 5a:4:1.hebrew: הא תברא ר"ע לגזיזיה - אין לפרש דחזר בו מדקתני שמשלם מגופו, דבפ' המניח (לקמן בבא קמא דף לג.) תני בהדיא: ר"ע אומר, כמשפט הזה — כתחתון ולא כעליון, יכול ישלם מן העלייה כו'. ולפ"ה נמי קשה, דפי': אע"ג דזימנין ליכא נזק שלם, כגון שהשור אין שוה כדי היזקו, מכל מקום ליתני תרי גווני שור, כיון דלפעמים איכא נזק שלם! וי"ל: דכיון דאין משלם אלא מגופו, אי אפשר למיתני גבי אבות, דאמרינן לקמן: כולם כאבות הן לשלם ממיטב:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 5a:4:1.english: Didn't Rabbi Akiva break his fist - One should not explain that he retracted [his opinion], [inferring this] from the fact that [the baraita] teaches that he pays from its body (mi-gufo); for in the chapter 'HaManiach' (below, Bava Kamma 33a), it teaches explicitly: Rabbi Akiva says: "According to this judgment" — like the lower [passage] and not like the upper [passage]; one might think he should pay from superior-quality property (min ha-aliyah), etc. And according to the explanation of the Kuntres [Rashi], it is also difficult, for he explained [that it is not considered full damages because payment is capped at the value of the ox; yet] even though sometimes there is no full damages — such as when the ox is not worth [the amount of] its damage — nevertheless, let [the Tanna] teach two types of ox, since sometimes there is full damages! And one can say: Since he pays only from its body (mi-gufo), it is impossible to teach [it] among the primary categories (avot), as we say below: "All of them are like primary categories to pay from superior-quality property (mi-meitav)."

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 5a:5:1.hebrew: האונס והמפתה והמוציא ש"ר דממונא הוא - מוציא שם רע לית ביה ממונא כלל, אלא מאה כסף; אלא אגב אחריני נקטיה:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 5a:5:1.english: The rapist, the seducer, and the defamer, which is monetary - A defamer has no monetary [compensation] at all, but only [the fine of] one hundred [pieces of] silver; rather, [the Gemara] mentioned it along with the others.

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 5a:7:1.hebrew: המטמא והמדמע - המ"ל: דלא תנא להו משום דלא מיחייב בשוגג:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 5a:7:1.english: One who causes ritual impurity and one who mixes - [The Gemara] could have said that [the Tanna] did not teach them because one is not liable [for them] in [a case of] inadvertence (shogeg).

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 5a:9:1.hebrew: דאי שמיה היזק - ואע"ג דחזקיה, דאמר שמיה היזק, איתותב בהניזקין (גיטין דף נג:), מ"מ ניחא ליה לאוקומי ברייתא דרבי חייא אביו אליביה:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 5a:9:1.english: For if it is considered damage - And even though Chizkiyah, who said [that] it is considered damage, was refuted in [the chapter of] HaNizakin (Gittin 53b), nevertheless, [the Gemara] preferred to establish the Baraita of Rabbi Chiyya, his father, in accordance with him.

Tosafot on Bava Kamma 5a:9:2.hebrew: וקתני היזק דלא מינכרא - והא דקתני שלשה גווני, לפי שהם שנויין בפ' הניזקין (גיטין נב:), כדקתני שומר חנם והשואל, נושא שכר והשוכר, דקתני גווני טובא:
Tosafot on Bava Kamma 5a:9:2.english: And he teaches damage that is not evident - And that which [the Tanna] teaches three types [is] because they are taught in Perek HaNizakin (Gittin 52b), just as he teaches "an unpaid bailee and a borrower, a paid bailee and a renter," where he teaches multiple types.
